say:1:1230341001:1.text: I've been through a lot with my comrades in the gang, many of whom are injured or crippled. How can I just leave them behind?
say:1:1230341001:1.source_cn: 水鬼帮里有不少兄弟，都是一起打拼过来的，大家伤的伤，残...
say:1:1230341001:1.male: I've been through a lot with my comrades in the gang, many of whom are injured or crippled. How can I just leave them behind?
say:1:1230341001:1.female: I've been through a lot with my comrades in the gang, many of whom are injured or crippled. How can I just leave them behind?

say:2:1230341002:1.text: Carmine Whispers didn't drive us out, but we have no idea how to make ends meet here.
say:2:1230341002:1.source_cn: 但是，就算血薇帮不对我们赶尽杀绝，我们还能干什么呢？
say:2:1230341002:1.male: Carmine Whispers didn't drive us out, but we have no idea how to make ends meet here.
say:2:1230341002:1.female: Carmine Whispers didn't drive us out, but we have no idea how to make ends meet here.

say:3:1230341003:1.text: It's tough to carve out a living in Rustport, and we aren't cut out to be entrepreneurs...
say:3:1230341003:1.source_cn: 想在锈锚港撕出一条生路，不容易。改做生意也没有基础……
say:3:1230341003:1.male: It's tough to carve out a living in Rustport, and we aren't cut out to be entrepreneurs...
say:3:1230341003:1.female: It's tough to carve out a living in Rustport, and we aren't cut out to be entrepreneurs...

say:4:1230341004:1.text: Maybe I'll be a fishmonger in the future for some peaceful days.
say:4:1230341004:1.source_cn: 也许，以后去卖卖鱼，过点平静的日子吧。
say:4:1230341004:1.male: Maybe I'll be a fishmonger in the future for some peaceful days.
say:4:1230341004:1.female: Maybe I'll be a fishmonger in the future for some peaceful days.
